lines.en: : Did I...fall asleep?
: Ayane, what are you doing? You’ve been staring at that naked notebook for like five minutes now.
: Please just call it blank, Ami. We gain literally nothing from personifying inanimate objects like that.
: Well, whatever the case is, I’m worried!
: Ayane’s supposed to be the bubbly, happy one! I’m supposed to be the one doing mildly unsettling things and making everybody uncomfortable!
: I’m glad to see that you’ve finally embraced it. What’s my role?
: I don’t know. Something sexual.
: Nice.
: Oh. Uhh...I was just finishing yesterday’s homework and...
: Sorry, did anything really weird just happen to anybody else? I feel like I just came back from another dimension again.
: Again? Is that something you do often?
: Yes, Ami. How about you?
: Whatever do you mean, best friend?
: I don’t know. What do I mean, best friend?
: Can you two stop bickering and just kiss already?
: We already have. And let the record show that Ayane was the aggressor which means she’s gayer than me.
: Ahh...youth. Can you smell that, Io?
: No, why? Did you buy another new perfume that I’m supposed to notice?

: No, the smell of love! Girls with boys. Boys with girls. Girls with girls and boys with boys and sometimes two girls with one boy when your name is Io and you believe in throuples! Isn’t it just intoxicating?!

: Not really. Also, are you hallucinating boys? Because we only know one of those and it would make sense if you suddenly decided to make a bunch of them up to increase your chances or fuel further fantasies.
: What do you mean another perfume? Do I buy them that often?
: Yes, but I assume it’s just your form of retail therapy, which isn’t all that harmful in small doses. It’s like me with different size screws. Just way more expensive and a lot less useful.
: Never underestimate how useful perfume can be when applied to the right situations, Io.
: Did you read that in a magazine?
: Maybe.

: Well, is it too late to cancel your subscription? Because your strategy clearly isn’t working based on the fact that you are in the very exclusive club of girls in 1-A who have not yet experienced any form of sexual contact.
: I’m just waiting for the right moment.
: Just out of curiosity, is there a wrong one?
: Duh. Like, funerals? No good.
: Is that the only one? I figured you would list more.
: I was about to say hatsumode but then I changed my mind because I think it would be hot to do it in a yukata.
: Yeah, I think you might need a little more counseling.
: Maybe a yukata might actually be the trick to make Sensei finally notice me?
: All this time, I’ve figured the maid costume would do him in. But I’m worried he may have started seeing me as some sort of god and not just a curious, flirty girl anymore.

: Regardless! It’s spring! Which means that love is in the air and that it’s time for me to once again start plotting out how to get Sensei’s attention at the beach! Also also how I will cope when I ultimately back down!
: I’d say to just be yourself, but I think that’s exactly why you’re in this predicament in the first place.
: How about some sort of calculated wardrobe malfunction? I’ll keep the string of my bathing suit loose, you can bump into me while I’m talking to Sensei, then boom!
: The ladies say hi, I cover ‘em up and run off all embarrassed, then he chases me down and comforts me before his lust gets the better of him and I wind up all sweaty and tied to a bike rack.
: What if somebody needs to get their bike?
: Well, they’ll obviously just have to wait! Hold on, does the inn even have a bike rack?
: It’s kind of a little too far out there to bike to, isn’t it? Oh well! Like, I’m not saying it needs to be a bike rack specifically. Pretty much anything within reach will do.
: A bike rack’s just the first thing that came to mind but, either way, this is all just an idea!
: Like, I obviously need some sort of push since I’ve been completely incapable of getting him to touch me on my own. But if unintentionally forcing me to go topless is a little much for you, I-
: Io?
: Something wrong? You get a text?
: Sorry, it’s nothing. What were you saying?
: Just...more stuff about battle plans and how to take the next step in my transition from girlhood to womanhood.
: Yeah, I don’t want to help you flash Sensei.
: Then we will think of something else! That was just a spur-of-the-moment idea anyway. And I-
: AHHHHH WHAT THE FRICK IS THAT?!?!?!
: Miku! Keep it down over there. Any louder and you’re going to scare yourself.
: Sorry, Miss Imai. But either some girl just accidentally sent me her nudes or I got myself a secret admirer I ain’t even remotely interested in...
: Someone...sent you nudes? Of all people?
: Of all people?! The heck is that supposed to mean?! Maki says all sorts’a girls are desirable and I was definitely a girl last time I checked!
: Uta, can you come to the nurse’s office with me? I think I forgot one of my medications in there.
: I don’t mean anything bad by that. There are plenty of people out there with...Miku-like preferences. I’m just surprised that it’s you and not someone like-
: Oh my God.
: Exactly! Someone like Futaba. That makes more sense.
: Futaba, your friggin’ boobs keep causin’ me problems even when they ain’t directly involved! Put those things away already!
: Uta...now?
: I’m sorry, I just...
: Just gonna...delete that.
: Okay, okay. So there’s some sorta inappropriate photo going around. But ain’t y’all ever seen a naked girl before? Just ignore it like it’s one of those chain messages and move on.
: M...Miss Imai is right. It’s just- ah!
: What’re you squeaking about over there, huh?
: I tried to delete it, but...it’s back and...ah! I just got...five more?!
: And I- HOLY HECK! SO DID I! GET A FRIGGIN’ GRIP, GIRL! I AIN’T INTERESTED!
: Have you tried texting back “STOP?” Could be some sort of robo-marketing thing for that store Makoto’s family definitely doesn’t run.
: I think we’d know if that was the case!
: Don’t just openly admit it! That’s supposed to be a secret!
: This reminds me once more of the corrupted blood incident. There’s naught we can do to quell the spread of the virus. Which means that this is, unfortunately, where we all die.
: I too have received these photographs. I am officially popular.
: Just turn your damn phones off if it’s gonna be such a distraction. Y’all are getting even louder than normal and I don’t want Wakana coming in here and yelling at me again. Understo-
: AHHHHH NO! GET THAT THING AWAY FROM ME, SANA! THIS IS A TOTAL INVASION OF...SOMEBODY’S PRIVACY! PROBABLY!
: I thought it was Miku for a second...
: Oh, real nice, Sana! Real nice! You ain’t all the impressive either!
: That is...an entire vagina.
: Let me see, let me see! I like vaginas! I like-
: Oh, jeez. Not that kind of vagina. I’m not trying to get put on a list.
: I’m just glad it’s not my sister. All I got was a closeup of a chest at first and thought I was being extorted.
: It looks kind of like Uta if anybody, doesn’t it?
: I don’t see Miku at all. And that’s coming from a place of great experience since I have seen her naked many, many times.
: Huh...Yeah, I can kind of see that. The hair definitely matches in some of the other pictures. Was Uta ever a tomboy, though?
: There are a few with school uniforms but I don’t recognize any of the colors, so it’s not Kumon-mi. Where’s Uta from again?
: Nara, but it’s obviously not her. Uta’s too sweet to ever take pictures this raunchy.
: She seems kind of quiet all of a sudden though, doesn’t she?
: Imani-
: I know, I know. I was just about to confiscate everyone’s phones and duct tape all their mouths shut. Sorry for all the noise.
: It’s happening here too then?
: Wait, too? Your kids are gettin’ this weird chain message thingy as well? Think the school messenger app might’ve gotten hacked or something?
: I have no clue, but-
: Guys! Have you already heard about the-
: We know. Go away.
: Okay.
: What do we even do for things like this? The teacher’s handbook didn’t say shit about nudie epidemics.
: SANA, STOP! SERIOUSLY! I DON’T WANT TO SEE!
: Why are you so afraid of girls all of a sudden?...You’re not afraid of me too now, are you?...
: Go show Nodoka then! She’s just sitting there!
: Yeah, that’s a Nara uniform. I just looked it up.
: That still doesn’t mean anything.
: Yeah, there’s no way of knowing if-
: CAN YOU ALL JUST FUCKING SHUT UP ALREADY?!

: DAY IN AND DAY OUT, EVERY SINGLE ONE OF YOU RANTS AND RAVES ABOUT SEX AND NOW YOU’RE GOING TO SIT THERE AND MAKE A BIG DEAL OUT OF SOMEBODY’S PRIVATE PHOTOS LIKE YOU’VE NEVER SEEN A FUCKING NAKED BODY BEFORE?!
: JUST SHUT UP! NOBODY GIVES A SHIT! IT’S A PICTURE! AND NONE OF YOU WOULD FUCKING CARE AT ALL IF YOU WEREN’T ALREADY SO FUCKING OBSESSED WITH ALL OF THIS NONSENSE!
: DELETE THE PICTURES. BLOCK THE NUMBER. TURN YOUR PHONES OFF. IT’S THAT FUCKING EASY!
: THIS IS A FUCKING SCHOOL! NOT A SEX CLUB! READ A FUCKING BOOK OR SOMETHING!
: Io’s right. Everybody, bring your phones to the front of the room. We’ll keep them in the office until the end of the day while we figure out what to do about this.
: Sh...Shouldn’t we contact the police? The girl in those photos is...um...well...
: The police aren’t going to fucking do anything! They’ll just tell you the same fucking thing I did!
: But they could at least trace the number or-
: You think someone who would mass text that disgusting crap to an entire class wouldn’t also take measures to hide their trail?!
: You think the police will look at those photos and find the culprit?! How fucking annoyingly optimistic does a person have to be to-
: Io, thank you. I can handle it. Everyone, bring your phones up here now. Not optional. Sorry.
: Ushibori, while I’m here, you left your bow outside after morning practice today. Come with me and I’ll unlock the equipment room for you.
: Go. Get out here. That’s your-
: It’s fine, Io.
: What?
: I said it’s fine.
: They’ve already figured it out.
: Uta! Don’t!
: Why, though?
: These are my friends.
: I shouldn’t have to hide who I am from them.
: They won’t care how many lonely men all over the globe have jerked off to my pictures. Or how many cum tributes were sent back to me.
: They won’t care how happy I was to take those photos. Or how happy I was sending them. Or how happy I am right now, knowing that some of them won’t actually delete them either.
: It brings me great joy knowing how many people I can make happy with my body. And that it doesn’t matter what shape, size, or age it is in order to do that.
: None of us can help what we like at the end of the day. And for me, that just happens to be this.
: I don’t mind it at all.
: I don’t mind it at all.
: I don’t mind it at all.
: Ami? What are you doing back so early? School doesn’t end for another four hours.
: Yeah, we all got sent home early. New question, though — have you gotten any weird pictures sent to your phone today?
: Uhh...no. Why?
: Are you telling the truth or are you lying to me right now because you don’t want to feel bad about keeping them?
: I haven’t gotten anything at all. Why? What’s going on?
: Everybody at school got some...pretty graphic pictures of Uta from when she was back in Nara.
: ...What?
: I feel really bad. She’s trying to shrug it off like it’s no big deal, but I know it’s getting to her.
: Anyway, that’s really it. Just wanted to keep you in the loop.
: Maybe give her some space for a little while? Getting involved now would probably just show her that you know something and I don’t want to make her feel even worse than she already does.
: You...all got those pictures?
: Lots of them. She, uhh...
: She was pretty active back in elementary school.
: You really didn’t get anything?
: No...I really didn’t.
: Huh...
: Weird...
Uta’s affection has increased to [uta_love]!
